messages:
Samira C: KitePay just pushed back on the security questionnaire — they want 7y retention for audit logs and HSM-backed key attestation. Deadline EOW.
Alex M: Ack. Which exact artifacts are they asking for? full logs, schema, or signed attestation?
Samira C: They listed: (1) sample exported auth logs with retention timestamps, (2) proof of KMS/HSM attestation and key rotation policy, (3) a short repro showing how we correlate request IDs to logs. Also asked about deletion proof for old data.
Nate I: On HSM: for hosted we use cloud KMS (managed HSM option available in some regions). We can provide CA-signed attestation docs from the provider, but we cannot export private keys. Private deployments can provide HSM evidence locally.
Emily S: For the sample logs we can generate an export of a small time range (redacted) and include request_id, route, timestamp, and outcome. We should avoid any PII — scrub IPs and user IDs.
Samira C: Customer asked for a reproducible example where a 401 occurs and the trace_id maps to the log line. They want reproduction steps we can hand to their auditors.
Alex M: Easy: provide curl example that hits their org-bound route + provide the corresponding request_id they should look for in the exported logs. Example snippet:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <$INVALID_TOKEN>" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-2b", "input":"test"}'
# response includes X-Request-Id: 01F8XYZ...
```

Include that request id in the export mapping.
Nate I: To produce the export: run the logs-export job (internal runbook). I can create a redacted CSV with columns: request_id, ts, model, route, status_code, latency_ms. Then run a hash proof that shows export integrity (sha256) and include the runbook steps.
Samira C: Awesome. Do we have a template attestation from cloud KMS to share? They specifically asked for something signed by an HSM CA.
Nate I: I'll attach the cloud KMS attestation PDF we get from provider (we keep a sanitized copy for customer sharing). Note: it states keys are HSM-protected and provides key rotation cadence; it isn't a long-form custom audit though.
Lydia (Legal): Confirm we can share the sanitized attestation and redacted logs with KitePay under their NDA. Also confirm retention change requests — are they asking us to change our retention policy or just to furnish exported samples proving a 7y plan?
Samira C: They phrased it as: "provide evidence we meet their retention requirements or an export and a plan/contractual commitment for retention." So likely a combination: export now + contractual addendum for future retention.
Emily S: Operationally, hosted customers default to 90d logs. For anything >90d they'd need a Dedicated or Private plan or a paid retention add-on. We should clearly state options.
Alex M: Let's propose two deliverables: (A) redacted log export + reproduction steps and trace mapping within 48 hrs, (B) an options doc outlining retention add-on / Dedicated/Private route with timelines to commit to 7y retention.
Samira C: Can engineering produce the export within 24-48h if I give a tight window? Their auditors want something by Friday COB.
Nate I: Yes, but need sample request_ids and timeframe to export. If they give us a narrow window (like last 7 days) we can do a quick export and scrub within 24h. For historical long-tail data we need a retention contract.
Samira C: I'll ask KitePay to provide 3 example request_ids and the date range for the export. Also ask for the auditor contact if they want follow-ups.
KMS Bot: NOTE: KMS attestation packaging ready v1.2. Contains provider-signed PDF and key rotation schedule. Access: eng-security only.
Emily S: I'll prepare the export template. Decision points: do we include raw ISO timestamps or convert to their TZ? Recommend UTC + offset note.
Alex M: Also mention that we cannot produce a deletion certificate for hosted unless they're on Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can show retention policy, retention engine logs, and deletion job audit entries proving deletion runs.
Lydia (Legal): Draft a short addendum: 'Redwood will maintain log retention per the selected plan. For hosted plan customers, retention guarantees limited to exported artifacts and retention policy; HSM attestation provided by cloud provider. Dedicated/Private customers can require on-prem HSM attestation under separate SOW.' I'll draft language once Samira confirms scope.
Samira C: Thanks. KitePay asked about billing spike observed during their audit: repeated retries causing token auth 401s and many retries inflated token usage. They want a breakdown by route.
Emily S: We can provide token/cost breakdown per route for the requested time range from billing logs. That will show retry patterns and cost impact.
Samira C: Perfect. I'll send KitePay the ask list and deadline. Will follow up in this thread with the request_ids and their auditor contact when they reply. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex M: Marking for eng: Nate, can you start the export runbook when Samira posts the ids? I'll be on stand-by for any mapping questions.
Nate I: On it. ETA: 24h after receiving ids. Will attach sha256 of export file.
Samira C: Thanks team :heart: — sending to KitePay now.
KMS Bot: Export job queued: export-2187659999-01. Notify @Nate I when ready.
Samira C: KitePay replied with three ids and auditor email. Pasting here (redacted): req_01F8A..., req_01F8B..., req_01F8C... Deadline still Friday COB.
Alex M: Got it. Nate — go ahead. Emily — prepare billing breakdown template.
Nate I: Starting export now. Will DM when finished and post the sha256 checksum to this thread.
Emily S: Billing breakdown ready. I'll attach CSV after export completes.
Samira C: Closing loop once we hand off attestation + export. Thank you all! :tada:
